name: Healthy Eating
overview: Scripture reveals that God provided a variety of foods for human sustenance, beginning with plants bearing seed and fruit as given in Genesis 1:29, and later expanding to include all moving creatures as stated in Genesis 9:3. Obedience to God in serving Him brings blessings upon our food and health, as promised in Exodus 23:25. Wisdom literature cautions against overindulgence, warning that excessive eating and drinking lead to poverty and disgrace (Proverbs 23:21, 25:27), emphasizing a balanced and disciplined approach to eating as part of honoring God.
